Avoid sun exposure, strenuous exercise, harsh skincare (strong actives, acids, retinoids) for some days. Follow aftercare instructions.

faqs.question: Who is a good candidate for Polynucleotide treatment and who should avoid it?
faqs.answer: Good candidates: people who want skin rejuvenation, improved texture, hydration, mild to moderate fine lines, dark circles, skin laxity, etc. Also those willing to follow aftercare. detail.title: Histology – Skin Biopsy & Microscopic Diagnosis Service
detail.description: Histology is a specialized laboratory service that involves the microscopic examination of skin tissues (biopsy) to diagnose various skin diseases, infections, tumors, and chronic inflammatory conditions. This test is often recommended by dermatologists when the visible symptoms are unclear or when a deeper understanding of the skin's cellular structure is needed for diagnosis. When is Histology Recommended? - Suspicious moles or lesions - Skin cancer screening - Chronic rashes or eczema - Autoimmune skin disorders - Fungal or bacterial infections - Unknown skin growths or lumps Procedure Includes: - Skin biopsy collection by a dermatologist - Tissue sent to lab for processing - Microscopic examination by a histopathologist - Detailed report for diagnosis and treatment planning Report Time: 5-7 working days (in most cases) Follow-up consultation is usually scheduled after results.
